story_type: fighter jet max vertical takeoff, cockpit camera
hook: An F-22 pilot's view, upside down over the base he just left.
narration: This is the view from an F-22 cockpit, upside down over the base it just took off from.
Major Josh Gunderson left the runway at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, and pulled straight up.
The ground slid away past his shoulder as the Raptor stood on its tail.
Its two engines have nozzles that swivel up and down, so the jet can keep its nose pointed where most fighters would stall.
Then the base swung back under the nose.
And this was only the opening of the F-22 Demonstration Team's routine.
outcome: Gunderson flew the max vertical takeoff and the opening maneuvers of the F-22 demonstration profile.
title: F-22 goes straight up, cockpit view
description:
Maj. Josh Gunderson of the F-22 Raptor Demonstration Team flies the Raptor's max vertical takeoff and the opening maneuvers of the demonstration profile at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska, July 16, 2020.
